tagline:
Your payments app.
No seed phrase in setup.
OS passkey + multi-cloud backups.
pairingCodeHint: Show this code on the logged-in phone and approve only if it matches.
pairSheetBody: Grant Bluetooth when prompted. Keep this screen open while the other phone scans, matches this code, and approves. Wallets, nsec, and the backup passphrase (if the other phone has cloud backup on) transfer over encrypted Bluetooth. Backup stays fully active on this phone. Passkeys are not transferred. If the other phone had no Nostr or Home backup, you will see a reminder to set one up.
termsAcrossManagers: iCloud Keychain, Google Password Manager, or 3rd party password manager.
termsDeviceOnlyBody: Dies with the phone. Enable cloud sync or export 24 words / Nostr package.
termsDeviceOnlyRisk: With no backup you will risk losing your funds.
termsZkLine1: We cannot see your balances or transactions
termsZkLine2: We cannot move, freeze, or recover your funds
termsZkLine3: We cannot reset a lost passkey or passphrase
termsZkLine4: We never store your seed or mnemonic
termsRespLine1: You alone control your keys and backups.
termsRespLine2: If you lose them with no backup, your bitcoin is gone.
termsDevHint: DEV: CSPRNG entropy (not passkey PRF). Mnemonic goes to Keystore only.
termsDevAuth: Confirm device unlock to create a dev wallet
passkeyCreatingCaption: Your phone is saving a new passkey that unlocks this wallet.
passkeyDerivingCaption: Building your wallet keys from the passkey proof.
passkeyMissingBody:
No matching Basic Wallet passkey was found.

Create needs a PRF-capable provider such as Google Password Manager.
passkeyCreateFailedBody: Could not create a passkey. Enable a passkey provider and try again.
passkeyNoManagerCaption: No passkey manager was detected on this device. You can continue without a passkey, or open system settings to enable one (for example Google Password Manager).
